The party

Some nights become part of a story.
Others begin a new one.

The energy that made SERENNA so renowned opens a new chapter: Réveillon Amares.

The venue

An extraordinary setting.
A celebration for the few.

On the edge of the marina, among yachts and the view of Balneário Camboriú, a New Year’s Eve designed for ONLY 600 GUESTS. From the first toast to sunrise.

Premium open bar

From start to finish.

Grey Goose Vodka, Bombay Sapphire Gin, Johnnie Walker Black Label Whisky, Chandon Sparkling Wine, Heineken Beer, Red Bull, St. Pierre Tonic Water and Coconut Water, Soft Drinks and Water.

On the cocktail menu: Aperol Spritz, Gin & Tonic, Gin / Vodka / Whisky with Red Bull, Fitzgerald, Negroni and Campari.

Open food

The excellence of Japanese cuisine,
signed by Brava Sushi.

A specially curated menu bringing together the best of Brava Sushi.

From late night to sunrise.

To complete the celebration, AMARES will feature an island of selected desserts and a special breakfast.

Lounges & tables

Your own space on a singular night.

For those who value exclusivity, comfort and the freedom to celebrate alongside the people who truly matter.
